comparison.objective: Route, tighten, buckle, and clip a child-seat harness; candidate registers industrial sensors.
comparison.physical_skill: Webbing routing, latching, and material management versus screwdriver manipulation and constrained rigid adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Both tongues and clip secured with routed, untwisted, fitted straps and safe release; candidate requires two ≤6 mm switch registrations.
comparison.reason: No meaningful objective or skill overlap beyond bimanual work. Candidate still lacks component dimensions and calibrated tightening physics.
